title: TravelerLocal — China travel facts for foreign visitors
description: Field-verified China travel facts for foreign visitors: booking walls, hotel registration, transit.
summary: Field-verified China travel facts for foreign visitors: booking walls, hotel registration, transit.
offersHint: Field-verified China travel facts for foreign visitors: booking walls, hotel registration, transit. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://www.travelerlocal.ai/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: get_city_facts
toolsPreview.description: Field-verified facts a foreign traveler needs for a Chinese city: which attractions need real-name/passport booking and when tickets release, official ticket channels (no resellers), whether hotels register foreign guests, whether foreign cards work via Alipay/WeChat, and honest local notes. Use for questions like 'how do I book X in <city>' or 'can foreigners stay in hotels in <city>'.

toolsPreview.name: check_attraction_booking
toolsPreview.description: How a foreigner books a specific Chinese attraction: real-name/passport requirement, ticket release time, whether it sells out, the OFFICIAL channel, and whether authorized resellers exist. Use for 'can foreigners book the Forbidden City / Terracotta Army / Mogao Caves and when do tickets release'.

toolsPreview.name: check_transit_eligibility
toolsPreview.description: Whether a traveler qualifies for China's 240-hour visa-free TRANSIT (not the 30-day visa-free entry). Needs nationality, the entry port/city, and whether they have an onward ticket to a THIRD country/region. Returns eligibility, regional limits, and the defining conditions.

toolsPreview.name: search_cities
toolsPreview.description: Search the cities TravelerLocal has field-verified pages for. Returns matching city names and page URLs. Use to discover coverage or resolve a place to a city.

toolsPreview.name: get_travel_playbook
toolsPreview.description: TravelerLocal's field-verified stance on the system-level things foreigners get wrong in China (not a specific place): paying when a foreign card fails, eSIM vs VPN and the firewall, the Chinese-phone-number wall, the first hour after landing, hotel foreigner-registration, and visa-free transit. Use for 'why does my card keep getting declined in China', 'do I need a VPN or an eSIM', 'do I need a Chinese phone number', 'what do I do when I land'.
